level.label: Level
level.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0 to 4.

r16.label: 16' reeds
r16.hover: The level of the 16' (bassoon) reed bank: 0 off. Range 0 to 1.5.

r8.label: 8' reeds
r8.hover: The level of the 8' (clarinet) reed bank: 0 off. Range 0 to 1.5.

r8_sharp.label: 8' sharp reeds
r8_sharp.hover: The level of the 8' reeds tuned sharp (violin, musette): 0 off. Range 0 to 1.5.

r8_flat.label: 8' flat reeds
r8_flat.hover: The level of the 8' reeds tuned flat (musette): 0 off. Range 0 to 1.5.

r4.label: 4' reeds
r4.hover: The level of the 4' (piccolo) reed bank: 0 off. Range 0 to 1.5.

beat.label: Musette beat
beat.hover: How fast the musette reeds beat against each other on A4. Range 0 to 12 Hz.

beat_flat.label: Flat reed beat
beat_flat.hover: How fast the flat reed beats, relative to the sharp one. Range 0 to 2.

beat_track.label: Beat across the range
beat_track.hover: Whether the beat stays the same in Hz (0) or in cents (1) across the range. Range 0 to 1.

cassotto.label: Cassotto
cassotto.hover: Whether the 16' and first 8' reeds sound through the tone chamber: on or off. Range off or on.

bellows.label: Shared bellows
bellows.hover: Whether each note has its own air (0) or every note shares one bellows (1). Range 0 to 1.

curve.label: Bellows curve
curve.hover: The shape of the curve from key pressure to bellows pressure: below 1 normal playing sits at mezzo-forte, above 1 it stays soft until you push. Range 0.3 to 1.5.

bel_ms.label: Bellows response
bel_ms.hover: How quickly the bellows pressure follows the keys. Range 5 to 300 ms.

valve.label: Pallet opening
valve.hover: The key pressure that opens the key's valve fully. Range 0.05 to 1.

throttle.label: Pallet throttle
throttle.hover: How much a half-open valve chokes the reed. Range 0.05 to 1.5.

chamber_ms.label: Pallet build-up
chamber_ms.hover: How long the pressure takes to build behind an opening valve. Range 1 to 100 ms.

release_ms.label: Pallet closing
release_ms.hover: How long the key's valve takes to close when the key is released. Range 3 to 200 ms.

speak_ms.label: Speaking time
speak_ms.hover: How long a reed takes to speak at a medium touch. Range 5 to 300 ms.

low_slow.label: Slow low reeds
low_slow.hover: How much slower the low reeds speak than the high ones. Range 0 to 1.

thresh.label: Reed threshold
thresh.hover: The pressure where the reed starts to sound. Range 0.005 to 0.3.

amp.label: Reed swing
amp.hover: How far the reed tongue swings at a full press. Range 0.5 to 5.

rest.label: Reed rest
rest.hover: How high the reed tongue rests above the plate. Range 0 to 2.

push.label: Reed push
push.hover: How far the tongue is pushed into the slot at a full press. Range 0 to 1.2.

gap.label: Reed gap
gap.hover: The reed's clearance gap: rounds off the cut-off of the air. Range 0.02 to 0.6.

exit.label: Reed exit
exit.hover: How the air leaves below the plate as the tongue swings through, tip first. Range 0.05 to 1.5.

down.label: Reed downstroke
down.hover: How open the reed is below the plate relative to above. Range 0 to 2.5.

constrict.label: Reed constriction
constrict.hover: The narrowing where the air flow saturates. Range 0.3 to 4.

pump.label: Reed pumping
pump.hover: How much air the tongue itself pumps. Range 0 to 1.5.

flat.label: Pitch drop
flat.hover: How far the pitch drops at a full press. Range 0 to 30 cents.

bend.label: Pallet bend
bend.hover: How far the pitch bends down at full bellows on a barely open valve. Range 0 to 100 cents.

spread.label: Reed tolerance
spread.hover: How far the reeds are allowed to be out of tune with each other. Range 0 to 3 cents.

voicing.label: Voicing
voicing.hover: How the level changes across the compass: above 0 the low notes are louder. Range 0 to 2.

ch_hz.label: Reed chamber frequency
ch_hz.hover: Where the reed chamber's resonance sits. Range 500 to 5000 Hz.

ch_db.label: Reed chamber peak
ch_db.hover: How strong the reed chamber's resonance is. Range 0 to 20 dB.

ch_q.label: Reed chamber sharpness
ch_q.hover: How narrow the reed chamber's resonance is. Range 0.4 to 5.

cas_hz.label: Cassotto tone
cas_hz.hover: How dark the tone chamber makes its reeds: the frequency above which it rolls off. Range 400 to 4000 Hz.

cas_leak.label: Cassotto leak
cas_leak.hover: How much of the highs still pass the tone chamber. Range 0 to 1.

grille_hz.label: Grille
grille_hz.hover: The brightness of the grille and body: the frequency above which they roll off. Range 2000 to 12000 Hz.

tilt.label: Voicing by timbre
tilt.hover: How much timbre changes the reeds' voicing. Range 0 to 1.

rev_pedal.label: Reverse on pedal
rev_pedal.hover: Whether pressing the pedal reverses the bellows: on or off. Range off or on.

rev_shake.label: Reverse on shake
rev_shake.hover: Whether a shake (the motion input) reverses the bellows: on or off. Range off or on.

rev_ms.label: Reversal gap
rev_ms.hover: How long the gap in the sound lasts when the bellows reverse. Range 20 to 300 ms.

life.label: Life
life.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.
